title: British MPs can cast a vote by walking down a corridor
body: For a formal vote in the House of Commons, MPs enter either the Aye or the No lobby beside the chamber. Tellers count people as they pass through, and the published division list records how each MP voted.
takeaway: A recorded division lets a voter see how their own representative stood on an individual question.
source: UK Parliament, Divisions and Aye and No Lobbies
visual: a parliamentary corridor opening into two separate passages

title: Ten countries founded the Council of Europe in 1949
body: On 5 May 1949, ten countries founded the Council of Europe in London. The organisation later established a human rights convention enforced through a court in Strasbourg.
takeaway: The continent's human rights court comes from a separate institution to the European Union's courts.
source: Council of Europe, The Council of Europe in Brief
